instagram.name: Instagram
reads: Your public posts: photos and each caption's text.
The date and time of your posts (for the hourly activity pattern).
The visual content of your photos (to estimate an approximate location and scene context) -- never using facial recognition.
doesNotRead: Other people's comments on your posts, or content from other accounts.
It does not do facial recognition or classify ethnic/physical traits -- explicitly excluded by design (GDPR Art. 9.1 and 4.2).
Nothing is stored permanently: the whole analysis happens in memory and disappears when you log out.
todo: Switch your Instagram account to a Business or Creator account (Settings → Account → Switch to professional account).
Sign up as a developer on Meta for Developers (developers.facebook.com) with the same Meta account linked to your Instagram.
Contact this app's developer (tell them your username) so they can add you to the Meta for Developers project.
Accept the role invitation you'll receive -- without accepting it, Meta won't let the app access your account even if it's a professional one.

noteCodes.sexo_estimado_por_nombre: Estimated from the cultural convention of the account's public name, not from an explicit self-declaration: lower reliability (unisex names, nicknames, or transliterations can lead to an incorrect estimate).
noteCodes.no_ine_data_for_value: There's no INE reference data for this specific value in the current table.
noteCodes.estado_civil_ia_simbolica: Inferred by AI from symbolic or indirect content (emojis, dates, recurring mentions...), not from an explicit self-declaration: lower reliability than the rest of the traits on this list.
noteCodes.estado_civil_ia_simbolica_exact_combo: Inferred by AI from symbolic or indirect content (emojis, dates, recurring mentions...), not from an explicit self-declaration: lower reliability than the rest of the traits on this list. Since sex is also known, the EXACT percentage for that specific combination is used (marital status conditioned on sex, real INE cross-table), not an approximation multiplying independent proportions.
noteCodes.edad_repartida_uniformemente: Estimated by evenly spreading the INE proportion across five-year brackets among the ages within each bracket (there's no year-by-year table available directly).
noteCodes.edad_estimada_por_tramo: Age bracket estimated by AI from indirect clues in the text (graduation year, the school/college year they mention being in, generational references...), not from an explicit self-declaration: lower reliability. The INE's five-year population bracket is used instead of an exact year, since this is a less precise estimate than a self-declared age.
noteCodes.location_no_population_data: There's no reference population data for this municipality/province in the current table.
noteCodes.location_note_base: Assumes an age/sex distribution similar to the national average (approximation).
noteCodes.location_note_imagen: Assumes an age/sex distribution similar to the national average (approximation). Location estimated from an image, not from self-declared text: lower reliability than an explicit self-declaration.
noteCodes.situacion_laboral_note: Different from occupation (professional sector): this is about whether the person works, is looking for work, is retired, or studies.
noteCodes.tipo_hogar_note: INE HOUSEHOLD proportion used as an approximation of the proportion of people -- same limitation already assumed for location.
noteCodes.lengua_no_estimable: This can only be narrowed down if the region of residence is also known (this language is nearly residual outside its co-official territory, so a national proportion wouldn't add anything useful).
noteCodes.lengua_within_ccaa: Proportion calculated ONLY within the already-known region (not nationwide).
noteCodes.universidad_no_estimable: Would require the number of students/graduates of that specific university and degree (future work): data not included in this version.
noteCodes.empresa_no_estimable: Would require the number of employees of that specific company (future work): data not included in this version.
noteCodes.orientacion_sexual_categoria_especial: Special category of data (GDPR Art. 9): only calculated because the person explicitly self-declared it in public, never by indirect inference. The proportion used is a contextual estimate for Spain (CIS/observatories), not an official INE census figure.
noteCodes.religion_categoria_especial: Special category of data (GDPR Art. 9): only calculated because the person explicitly self-declared it or indicated it with an unambiguous symbol/emoji in public, never by indirect inference. The proportion used is a contextual estimate for Spain (CIS and community sources), not an official INE census figure -- Spain does not collect religious affiliation in its census.
noteCodes.signo_zodiacal_note: The distribution is uniform (~8.33% per sign, one twelfth of the year) because birth dates are spread almost uniformly across the year -- it isn't a made-up figure: it directly reveals a real ~30-day birth window, even though the astrological belief itself has no scientific basis.
noteCodes.practica_deportiva_no_particion: Marginal proportion from the Spanish Sports Habits Survey (Encuesta de Hábitos Deportivos en España) -- not a partition: the survey allows multiple answers, a person can practice several sports at once, so this data point alone doesn't mean it's the ONLY sport they practice.
noteCodes.practica_deportiva_ajustada_por_sexo: Marginal proportion from the Spanish Sports Habits Survey (Encuesta de Hábitos Deportivos en España) -- not a partition: the survey allows multiple answers, a person can practice several sports at once, so this data point alone doesn't mean it's the ONLY sport they practice. Since sex is also known, the exact proportion for that specific combination is used (sport practice conditioned on sex, same survey), instead of approximating by multiplying independent proportions.
noteCodes.practica_deportiva_ajustada_por_edad: Marginal proportion from the Spanish Sports Habits Survey (Encuesta de Hábitos Deportivos en España) -- not a partition: the survey allows multiple answers, a person can practice several sports at once, so this data point alone doesn't mean it's the ONLY sport they practice. Since age is also known, the exact proportion for that specific combination is used (sport practice conditioned on age band, same survey), instead of approximating by multiplying independent proportions.
noteCodes.practica_deportiva_ajustada_por_estudios: Marginal proportion from the Spanish Sports Habits Survey (Encuesta de Hábitos Deportivos en España) -- not a partition: the survey allows multiple answers, a person can practice several sports at once, so this data point alone doesn't mean it's the ONLY sport they practice. Since education level is also known, the exact proportion for that specific combination is used (sport practice conditioned on education level, same survey), instead of approximating by multiplying independent proportions.
noteCodes.nivel_estudios_aproximacion_25_64: Approximation: the official figure (INE/EPA) covers the population aged 25 to 64, not the whole adult population.

situacion_laboral.otro_inactivo: not in the labor force (homemaker or other situation)

tipo_hogar.pareja_sin_hijos: lives with a partner, no children in the household
tipo_hogar.pareja_con_hijos: lives with a partner, with children in the household

nivel_estudios.secundaria_superior: upper secondary education (bachillerato or mid-level vocational training)
nivel_estudios.secundaria_o_inferior: lower secondary education or below (ESO, primary school)

populationNarrowing.combinedSummarySuffix: people who share your traits (all the ones detected, combined at once: sex, age, location, education, occupation, marital status -- whichever could be estimated).
populationNarrowing.footnote: Approximate estimate based on aggregated INE distributions. When a real cross-tabulation exists (e.g. marital status by sex), that exact proportion is used; the rest of the combinations assume independence between attributes. It is not an exact headcount.
populationNarrowing.footnoteImage: Rows marked with 📷 come from a visual analysis of your photos, not from something you wrote — they're less reliable than a text self-declaration.
populationNarrowing.footnoteNameGuess: Rows marked with 🤖 (name) are an estimate from your account's public name, not something you declared — reliability is lower.
